semantics.root_rule: `import` is a non-executable family root by default.
semantics.family_rule: Intermediate modality/type families may contain deeper subcommands.
semantics.concrete_rule: Only explicit concrete import descendants are invocable.
semantics.profile_rule: Each concrete command binds exact import/parser/profile identity.
semantics.candidate_rule: Import command produces candidate imported content until explicit apply.
semantics.help_rule: Help is recursively generated from family metadata.
semantics.authority_rule: Import command availability grants no apply authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
